summary.text: Lew Frederick is a Democratic member of the Oregon State Senate for District 22, representing most of north and northeast Portland.
His biography says he first took office in October 2009 as an appointed representative from House District 43 and was elected to the Senate in 2016.

paragraphs.text: Frederick was born in Pullman, Washington, and grew up in the South, Midwest and New England, according to his biography.
He attended Earlham College in Indiana, is a PhD candidate at Portland State University, and has studied at MIT, Morehouse College and the Woods Hole Marine Biological Laboratories.
His professional career included seventeen years as a television reporter at KGW-Channel 8 in Portland and thirteen years as director of public information for Portland Public Schools.
He works as a strategic communications consultant and is a former board member of the Oregon State Board of Education, the Oregon Shakespeare Festival and the Oregon Museum of Science and Industry.
His stated legislative focus is justice in public safety, education and economic security.
